svg.text: CVA6 Suite 10: Aligned Sub-Word Memory Operations (Phase 1)
Cycle-accurate waveform showing SB, SH write byte enables and LB, LBU, LH, LHU sign/zero extensions

g.text: • Byte Accesses (SB / LB / LBU): Stored 0x11, 0x88, 0x33, 0xAA into 0x80000400..403. LB from offset 1 correctly sign-extended 0x88 to 0xFFFFFF88; LBU zero-extended to 0x00000088.
• Halfword Accesses (SH / LH / LHU): LH from offset 0 returned 0xFFFF8811 (sign-extended bit 15); LHU returned 0x00008811. LH from offset 2 returned 0xFFFFAA33.
• Word Consistency (LW): Reading full 32-bit word verified exact byte ordering 0xAA338811. SH stores then overwrote halfwords to 0x99775544 with zero data corruption.
